name: Teams Phone
description: Teams Phone brings cloud calling, PSTN connectivity, telephone-number management, call queues, auto attendants, and telephony administration into Microsoft Teams.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Microsoft 365 administrator through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth, then let selected agents inspect bounded, masked telephone-number assignment state without assignee, location, call-record, or full-number data.

capabilities.label: Read masked number inventory
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded Teams Phone assignment state without assignee, location, or full-number data.

approvalRequired.label: List number assignments
approvalRequired.description: List one bounded page of masked Teams Phone number-assignment metadata.

approvalRequired.label: List unassigned numbers
approvalRequired.description: List one bounded page of masked, currently unassigned Teams Phone numbers.

blocked.label: Private telephone data
blocked.description: Full telephone numbers, assignment-target IDs, operator IDs, emergency locations, addresses, network sites, and raw assignment IDs are not returned.

blocked.label: Number changes
blocked.description: Number assignment, unassignment, activation, porting, location changes, policy changes, and ordering are not exposed.

blocked.label: Call records and content
blocked.description: PSTN and Direct Routing call records, participant identity, call diagnostics, recordings, transcripts, voicemail, messages, and contacts are not exposed.

blocked.label: Call control
blocked.description: Calling bots, PSTN dialing, answering, transfer, redirect, media access, tones, and meeting operations are not exposed.

blocked.label: Raw Microsoft Graph
blocked.description: Arbitrary Graph paths, OData expressions, pagination links, caller-selected origins, and raw tokens are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every organization-wide masked number-inventory read requires matching Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected masked inventory reads run without Relay per-action approval while fixed Graph paths, filters, bounds, masking, audits, Microsoft scopes, tenant roles, licensing, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts two approval-aware masked Teams Phone inventory tools and attaches delegated Microsoft OAuth server-side.
Railway mounts two approval-aware masked Teams Phone inventory tools and attaches delegated Microsoft OAuth server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's multi-tenant Entra application must add delegated TeamsTelephoneNumber.Read.All, the exact production callback, publisher verification and admin-consent readiness before a licensed Microsoft 365 administrator can connect.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure the Relay-owned Entra application and Railway credentials, complete administrator consent in a test tenant with Teams Phone inventory, verify tenant and role binding, exercise Safe denial/approval and Dangerous reads, test refresh and disconnect, then deploy through the integration lane and run live acceptance.

evidence.supports: Microsoft Graph v1.0 documents tenant telephone-number assignment listing with delegated or application TeamsTelephoneNumber.Read.All and bounded OData top and filter parameters.
Microsoft documents number-assignment fields including number type, activation state, capabilities, source, assignment category and assignment status; Relay masks or excludes private identifiers.
Microsoft separates telephone-number mutation behind TeamsTelephoneNumber.ReadWrite.All; Relay does not request that permission or mount assignment actions.
Microsoft describes sensitive tenant-wide call-record and diagnostic data under separate CallRecords.Read.All application permission; Relay excludes this surface.
Microsoft documents separate bot calling and media APIs with broad application permissions and compliance constraints; Relay excludes call control and media.
